title: spec: BlueprintObjectSchema does not apply the stage-field option-kind rule ObjectSchema enforces, so apply_blueprint stages half a build
body:
repo:cloud#4 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdARJtc4RgABPH7PHk

Filing gate: finding from the cloud lane (cloud#4339, PR objectstack-ai/cloud#4409, merged).

## What
`/api/v1/mcp` apply_blueprint with `stageField: 'status'` whose options carry no `kind` passes blueprint validation; the object write then fails `Option 'draft' of field status declares no kind …`, yet the call answers `status: 'drafted'` having staged that object's kanban view and nav entry (2 dangling references in verify_build; cloud#4339 comment 6819231279).

Evidence: `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts` — option `kind` is described as REQUIRED under stageField but not enforced; `BlueprintObjectSchema`'s only refinement is `refuseUnfitDefaultValue` (main ~:344), vs `ObjectSchema`'s `refuseStageFieldWithoutKinds` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` ~:2803).

## Expected
`BlueprintObjectSchema` applies the same stage-field option-kind refinement, so cloud's existing `SolutionBlueprintSchema.safeParse` refuses such a blueprint with nothing staged. Pin test. (Cloud-side defence in depth — not staging a failed object's dependents — stays a cloud follow-up if wanted.)

Dedupe words: stageField kind blueprint, BlueprintObjectSchema stageField option kind, apply_blueprint half staged. Adjacent: objectstack#32396. Related: cloud#4339.
